subject: EOQ alignment check — POC scope & procurement timing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tran <alice@finarc.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ alignment check — POC scope & procurement timing

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + next steps so we’re aligned before you circulate this internally.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary goal: reduce inference unit cost for interactive search & summarization while keeping 95th pct latency < 300ms.
- Current friction: on-prem data isolation requirement + procurement wants clear runbook and SOC2 evidence.
- Success metric for POC: 20–30% token cost reduction at production-like qps; no user-facing latency regressions.

Proposed POC (attached: redwood-poc-outline.pdf)
- 3-week pilot against a representative subset: 2 models (base + quantized), 1k concurrent sessions ramp, synthetic load + small real traffic sample.
- Deliverables: cost/latency report, rollback plan, integration checklist for your infra team.

Questions / asks for your team
1) Is there a target approval date on your end? You mentioned trying to close vendor decisions before month/quarter end — is EOQ (Aug 31) still the target?
2) Can I get a contact on procurement to share the runbook and SOC2 summary?
3) Any additional constraints (network, outbound ports, KMS) we should bake into the POC?

Next steps I propose
- I’ll send the POC outline and a short quote for the pilot (attached).
- If legal/procurement wants the SOC2 summary now I can share an exec SR and SOC2 attestation.
- If EOQ is still the target, can we lock a procurement touchpoint this week? 30-min slot will do.

I’ll follow up mid-week if I don’t hear back — appreciate any timing color so we can prioritize engineering slots.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-poc-outline.pdf (3 pages)
Attachment: redwood-final-quote.xlsx (stub, 1 sheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tran <alice@finarc.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ alignment check — POC scope & procurement timing

Hi Alice — quick bump on this.

If EOQ is still on the table, we can prioritize a dedicated infra engineer for the week of Aug 25 to help with onboarding (short window). If timing has slipped, no worries — just let me know and we’ll adjust the POC schedule so it maps to your approval horizon.

Proposed short options:
- Option A: Procurement call this week (30 min) -> pilot kickoff Aug 26 -> deliver week of Sep 15.
- Option B: Procurement call next week -> kickoff early Sep.

Which option looks realistic on your side?

Thanks — Marissa

> Hi Alice — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + next steps so we’re aligned before you circulate this internally.
> ...
From: Alice Tran <alice@finarc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ alignment check — POC scope & procurement timing

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the follow-ups and the clear plan. Short update from my side: we are still very interested, but a couple of internal shifts mean procurement needs a bit more time.

What changed:
- Head of Ops is out this week; procurement is deprioritizing vendor onboarding until they return.
- Budget for new vendors is expected to be confirmed by mid-September rather than EOQ.

What I need from Redwood to keep this moving:
1) A short SOC2 summary (controls high-level + scope) to satisfy procurement initial screen — can you send that?
2) A one-page POC timeline that explicitly lists who from Redwood will be involved and the expected slippage if we start in mid-Sep.

Happy to still aim for an internal alignment call the week of Sep 8; I’ll loop procurement once I have the doc set. If you can send the SOC2 summary and the requested timeline I’ll fast-track it.

—
Alice
Head of Data Products, Finarc
alice@finarc.com

Date: Thu, 28 Aug 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EOQ alignment check — POC scope & procurement timing

Thanks Alice — helpful clarity. Quick reply and concrete next moves to keep momentum heading into Sep: 

1) SOC2 summary: attached (soc2-summary.pdf) — outlines scope, controls, and attestation date. If procurement wants the full report we can arrange an NDA and a secure share.
2) One-page POC timeline: attached (redwood-poc-outline.pdf — updated with mid-Sep start and named engineers).
3) Proposal/quote: I’ve updated the pilot quote to reflect a mid-Sep kickoff (see redwood-final-quote.xlsx).

If you’d like, here are two concrete next steps we can lock:
- A: Procurement touchpoint — 30 min — Tue Sep 9, 10:00–10:30 PT (I’ll bring Rishi to answer infra/process questions).
- B: DocuSign for the pilot statement of work — I can send the link once procurement confirms scope.

Question for planning: is Finarc still aiming to finalize vendor decisions in September, or should we plan for an October window? A quick yes/no helps us batch engineering availability.

I’ll hold the Aug 26 infra slot until EOD PST tomorrow — if you don’t need it we’ll free it up.

Thanks again — looking forward to keeping this moving.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
